# Grand Opening of Upgraded Regional Operating Facility In Nashville

Aug 07, 2026

Nashville, TN – Five Star Breaktime Solutions recently celebrated the opening of a consolidated regional office and distribution facility in Antioch, a neighborhood of Nashville, TN. This opening marks the second building relocation for Five Star this year, following a recent move in Dothan, AL.

 Over the last decade, the company outgrew its previous building several times, splitting departments into multiple locations due to service expansion, economic development, and surging customer base growth across Middle Tennessee. The new 80,000-square-foot facility consolidates four separate buildings into one centralized hub for service to metro Nashville and the surrounding counties. The combined usable square footage of the previous facilities totaled approximately 55,000 square feet, making the new distribution center a significant expansion that better supports daily operations, improves efficiency, and enhances employee morale.

# Inauguración de OMNILIFE representa expansión de empresas mexicanas al norte de Texas 

#### Escrito por Movida Hispana el 15 agosto, 2026 

Allen, Texas.— El norte de Texas fue escenario de un momento significativo para la expansión internacional de una de las compañías mexicanas con mayor presencia en la industria de la venta directa, con la puesta en marcha de OMNILIFE Innovation Park un nuevo complejo corporativo, logístico y productivo de la compañía en Allen.

Movida Hispana estuvo presente el viernes 14 de agosto de 2026 en la inauguración oficial de OMNILIFE Innovation Park, una compañía que tiene como visión a largo plazo la posibilidad de incorporar nuevas líneas de producción y categorías de productos en el futuro.

La apertura de OMNILIFE representa un paso importante dentro de su estrategia internacional y una oportunidad para fortalecer su capacidad de producción y distribución en el mercado estadounidense.

# OMNILIFE opens North American manufacturing platform in Allen, Texas, with $64M+ investment

News Provided By Vaquero Advertising August 18, 2026, 17:24 GMT 

OMNILIFE’s new 550,000-square-foot Innovation Park expands U.S. manufacturing and distribution to support long-term growth in North America.

 ALLEN, TX, UNITED STATES, August 18, 2026 / EINPresswire.com/ -- OMNILIFE, an international dietary supplement and personal care company with 35 years of history and a presence in more than 20 countries, has opened OMNILIFE Innovation Park, a corporate, logistics, and production complex built with an investment of more than $64 million. The project brings together the company’s U.S. corporate headquarters, a nationwide distribution center, and OMNILIFE’s first manufacturing plant on U.S. soil. The new plant begins producing part of the portfolio intended for the U.S. market, while operations in Mexico and Colombia continue to supply the rest of demand.
